cover: Original warm gouache cover illustration, portrait 3:4, for a Cambodian Grade 1 picture book about looking for a ginger kitten. Sophea is a six-year-old Cambodian girl, warm brown skin, two short straight black pigtails with mint ties, mint-green short-sleeve T-shirt and navy knee-length shorts. She kneels barefoot beside a low teak table on a shaded wooden family veranda, looking curiously under the table. A tiny ginger tabby kitten with white chin and paws, no collar, peeks from behind a lavender square cushion at the side of a straw woven mat. A single turquoise ceramic water bowl sits near the girl. Leafy banana plants and a warm wooden door in the distance. Cozy painted storybook, soft colored-pencil grain, expressive face, simple large silhouettes, peach wood and gentle greens. The girl's head, cat and cushion are below the top quarter, which is quiet light cream for separately typeset Khmer. No letters, numbers, logos, text or watermarks. Use this to establish a reusable character and setting reference.
